scrapeMode.title: Scraping Mode
scrapeMode.description: Select the Facebook data module to execute, or choose AUTO_DETECT to automatically identify the URL type.

startUrls.title: Target URLs
startUrls.description: List of Facebook URLs (Pages, Groups, Marketplace, Reels, Events, or Posts).

maxItems.title: Max Items / Posts / Listings per URL
maxItems.description: Maximum number of items (posts, group discussions, marketplace products, reels, or photos) to collect.

maxComments.title: Max Comments per Post
maxComments.description: Maximum number of comments to extract when scraping posts or comments mode.

marketplaceCity.title: Marketplace Location / City (Optional)
marketplaceCity.description: City filter for Marketplace searches (e.g. Paris, New York, Casablanca, London).

adsCountry.title: Ads Library Target Country
adsCountry.description: Country code for Facebook Ads Library scraping (e.g. US, FR, MA, GB, ALL).

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy settings. Residential proxies are recommended for Facebook to prevent blocks.

customCookies.title: Facebook Session Cookies (Optional)
customCookies.description: Optional Facebook cookies (JSON array or 'c_user=...; xs=...' format) to scrape in logged-in state or access private groups.
